coverage: Disposable SQLite tests cover synchronized same-nonce races across spawned processes, distinct-nonce concurrency, restart persistence, revocation visibility and race ordering, durable reservation retention, transactional failure, bounded cleanup, lock timeout, missing/corrupt/incompatible/read-only/symlink/path failures, live factory requirements/no fallback, fail-closed authentication before nonce consumption, raw-material exclusion, and gateway lifespan initialization before activity.
limits: Synthetic identities/clock and temporary local SQLite only. Shared-filesystem deployment boundary is one host; this does not establish PostgreSQL, multi-host/distributed storage, production DID provider, real ingress/TLS, operator custody, or testnet readiness. No live database, key, transaction, or network used.

independent_review.scope: checksums, six current source/test hashes, captures, SQLite multiprocess behaviors and single-host limits
